question.en: Does what Madam Bellinsky said come true?
question.zh: 别林斯基夫人说的话应验了吗？

sentences.en: Does what Madam Bellinsky said come true?
sentences.zh: 别林斯基夫人说的话应验了吗？

sentences.en: At a village fair, I decided to visit a fortune-teller called Madam Bellinsky.
sentences.zh: 在一个乡村集市上，我决定去拜访一位叫别林斯基夫人的算命先生。

sentences.en: I went into her tent and she told me to sit down.
sentences.zh: 我走进她的帐篷，她让我坐下。

sentences.en: After I had given her some money, she looked into a crystal ball and said:
sentences.zh: 我给了她一些钱后，她看着水晶球说：

sentences.en: 'A relation of yours is coming to see you.
She will be arriving this evening and intends to stay for a few days.
The moment you leave this tent, you will get a big surprise.
sentences.zh: 您一离开这个帐篷，就会大吃一惊。

sentences.en: A woman you know well will rush towards you.
sentences.zh: 一位您很熟悉的女人会向您跑来。

sentences.en: She will speak to you and then she will lead you away from this place. That is all.'
sentences.zh: 她会和您说话，然后把您从这儿带走。就这些。”

sentences.en: As soon as I went outside, I forgot all about Madam Bellinsky because my wife hurried towards me.
sentences.zh: 我一走出去，就把别林斯基夫人忘得一干二净，因为我妻子正朝我匆匆走来。

sentences.en: 'Where have you been hiding?' she asked impatiently.
sentences.zh: “你躲到哪儿去了？”她不耐烦地问。

sentences.en: 'Your sister will be here in less than an hour and we must be at the station to meet her. We are late already.'
sentences.zh: “你妹妹不到一小时就到了，我们得去车站接她。我们已经晚了。”

sentences.en: As she walked away, I followed her out of the fair.
sentences.zh: 她走开时，我跟着她走出了集市。
